scope_limits: Bounded native startup repair only: wire main.go and pkg/permissionbundle/install.go to a real native single-writer continuous-lineage authority path (AuthorityModeNativeSingleWriterV1 = native_single_writer_lineage_v1)

Intended bounded profile is one existing native writer with uninterrupted durable store lineage across normal process restart; no concurrent writer, HA failover, or point-in-time restore support claimed
Refuse unavailable/inconsistent authority, wrong incarnation, missing/corrupt state, journal/key loss, or SQL regression behind host authority checkpoint
No always-success driver, constant lineage, no-op acknowledgements, or MySQL read_only / same-DB counter passed off as independent recovery proof
No octo-im / WuKongIM code, config, schema, API or service change, task, PR or delegation
No unselected XIN-2830 product proposals, restore markers, history contract changes, or replay key changes
No production allowlist, live deployment, ready, merge, or acceptance claim

contract_diff_vs_handoff_v9.wire_routes_and_json_schemas: UNCHANGED — all route paths, query parameters, auth headers, and JSON request/response schemas match handoff-v9.json and pkg/permissionbundle/contracts/permission-native-facts-v1.schema.json
contract_diff_vs_handoff_v9.native_single_writer_authority_mode: ADDED — OCTO_PERMISSION_BUNDLE_AUTHORITY_MODE=native_single_writer_lineage_v1 constructs NativeSingleWriterLineageDriver wrapped in FencedAuthorityAdapter at main.go:installPermissionBundle(ctx) -> InstallFromEnvWithHooks -> InstallOptIn, plus post-migration VerifyAfterSetup(ctx) after module.Setup(ctx)
contract_diff_vs_handoff_v9.provisioned_scope_enforcement_on_facts: ENHANCED — under AuthorityModeNativeSingleWriterV1, Runtime.Facts (POST /v1/bot/permission-facts/v1) and Runtime.BindDeliveredMessage (POST /v1/bot/permission-facts/v1/bind-delivery) enforce Store.verifyProvisionedScope (Store.readFOR SHARE + loadRelease + catalogMembers) inside the RepeatableRead transaction, ensuring missing/retired/corrupt/wrong-incarnation bot_permission_scope rows fail closed on every fact and recovery call
contract_diff_vs_handoff_v9.agent_recovery_contract: REUSES CHECKED PATHS — Agent (XIN-2795) can verify current scope and 2-authority (sql + im) ack_before_read_start lineage cuts on startup/restart via GET /v1/bot/permission-bundle/v1?space_id=<space_id> and POST /v1/bot/permission-facts/v1?space_id=<space_id> (operation=resolve or history_disclosure) using its bf_ User Bot token

opt_in_startup_composition.entrypoint: main.go:installPermissionBundle(ctx) -> permissionbundle.InstallFromEnvWithHooks(ctx, nil, nil, message.NewServerMessageFactHooks(ctx)) followed by permissionbundle.VerifyAfterSetup(ctx) after module.Setup(ctx)

env_variables.OCTO_PERMISSION_BUNDLE_ENABLED: true | 1 | yes | on (unset/false is a no-op leaving RuntimeFor(ctx) == nil)
env_variables.OCTO_PERMISSION_BUNDLE_AUTHORITY_ID: optional SQL authority id for native_single_writer_lineage_v1 (default sql-native-writer)
env_variables.OCTO_PERMISSION_BUNDLE_AUTHORITY_INCARNA: explicit 32-hex SQL authority incarnation (falls back to OCTO_PERMISSION_BUNDLE_STORE_INCARNATION when unset)
env_variables.OCTO_PERMISSION_BUNDLE_AUTHORITY_STATE_P: required path to 0600 regular file storing HMAC-authenticated host authority checkpoint for native_single_writer_lineage_v1
env_variables.OCTO_PERMISSION_BUNDLE_AUTHORITY_KEY_HEX: optional >=64-hex (>=32-byte) HMAC key for authority lineage (falls back to OCTO_PERMISSION_BUNDLE_PERMIT_KEY_HEX when unset)
env_variables.OCTO_PERMISSION_BUNDLE_AUTHORITY_PROVISI: true | 1 on initial bootstrap of a clean store; false | 0 on normal restarts (refuses if state is missing)
env_variables.OCTO_PERMISSION_BUNDLE_STORE_AUTHORITY_I: optional IM/message store authority id (default octo-server-message-store)
env_variables.OCTO_PERMISSION_BUNDLE_STORE_INCARNATION: required 32-hex store incarnation when mode is octo_server_message_store_v1
env_variables.OCTO_PERMISSION_BUNDLE_PERMIT_KEY_HEX: required >=64-hex (>=32-byte) HMAC key when mode is octo_server_message_store_v1
env_variables.OCTO_PERMISSION_BUNDLE_DURABLE_PERMIT_LE: true | 1 enabling SQL table bot_permission_disclosure_permit (auto-created via ServerDisclosurePermitDDL when OCTO_PERMISSION_BUNDLE_AUTHORITY_PROVISION=true)

agent_current_state_and_recovery_contrac.summary: Reuses existing checked bf_-authenticated Bot endpoints without adding unapproved routes or schema changes

step_1_current_bundle_and_scope_anchor_c.guarantees: Executes RepeatableRead transaction verifying active FencedAuthority (AcquireCurrent/AssertCurrent/RecordAcknowledgedPosition), active Native.Scope (bot user, robot, space, bot space_member, human creator), and existing non-retired bot_permission_scope row whose native_anchor_json.authority_incarnation equals the active SQL authority incarnation. Never auto-provisions on GET.

step_2_authority_lineage_cut_check.guarantees: Under native_single_writer_lineage_v1, verifies provisioned non-retired bot_permission_scope row + active Native.Scope + both sql and im authority cuts (each with 32-hex incarnation, monotonic position, 32-hex read_nonce, and consistency='ack_before_read_start'). Returns 200 OK ResolveResponse with 2-element authorities array and status='unavailable' for the synthetic probe reference, or HTTP 400 if scope/authority/membership is missing, retired, corrupt, or mismatched.
